declaredScope: Four original summaries of assessment terminology, not a copy or complete import of the WHO glossary.

source.title: Principles and Methods for the Risk Assessment of Chemicals in Food, EHC 240, Annex 1: Glossary of Terms
source.rights: WHO publication: all rights reserved. Original NutriScan summaries and source/page references only; full glossary reproduction/import and redistribution are not authorized by this record.

terms.label: Acceptable daily intake (ADI)
terms.scope: Food chemicals covered by the source definition
terms.summary: A toxicological reference for long-term daily ingestion, scaled to body mass. It is not a recommended nutrient intake or a measured exposure.

terms.label: ADI not specified; historical ADI not limited
terms.scope: Food-additive definition; veterinary-drug wording is separate in the original source
terms.summary: The committee judged a numerical ADI unnecessary given very low toxicity and anticipated uses plus background exposure. Good Manufacturing Practice still matters; this status does not mean unlimited use or an individual safety guarantee.

terms.label: No ADI allocated
terms.scope: JECFA terminology; consult the specific evaluation for its reason
terms.summary: An ADI was not established. Reasons may involve incomplete safety evidence, missing use information or absent identity/purity specifications. Read the individual evaluation; this differs from judging a numerical ADI unnecessary.

terms.label: Temporary ADI
terms.summary: A time-limited reference awaiting evidence and review, rather than completed lifetime assurance. The source describes an additional safety margin and a deadline for data needed to resolve remaining questions.
